messages:
mari: Heads-up — noticed a cluster of new users created via SSO that do not have profile.employeeNumber and were provisioned with org-admin after yesterday's RBAC refactor. Repro + logs below.

mari: SAML assertion sample (sensitive parts redacted):
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name=\"roles\">
    <AttributeValue> </AttributeValue>
  </Attribute>
  <!-- employeeNumber attribute missing entirely -->
</AttributeStatement>
```

devin: Did we change the Okta mapping recently? Which claim are we relying on now?

mari: Mapping was changed in the refactor: we map from claim `roles` -> app role, otherwise fallback to `default_role: org-admin` (old behavior carried over). If the claim is present but empty, the fallback fires.

alex: This is JIT provisioning (creates on successful SSO), right? Can we flip JIT off quickly?

okta-admin: Confirmed JIT is active for the app (Okta->SCIM create enabled). I can disable JIT and change the default role. Quick mitigation: disable provisioning create on the app and change default to `user`. Doing that now.

security-bot: Alert: 12 new users created via SSO in the last 30m with missing employeeNumber.

mari: We need an allowlist and to revoke any unintended admin sessions. Okta query to find candidates: 
`curl -s -H 'Authorization: SSWS $TOKEN' \"https://{org}.okta.com/api/v1/users?filter=profile.employeeNumber+eq+null\"`
(or use Okta UI -> People -> Filter).

devin: I'll also cross-check our DB: 
```sql
SELECT id, email, roles FROM users WHERE sso_created = true AND employee_number IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;
```

alex: On the Redwood side we should search audit events: look for `auth.sso.jit.create` and `role.assign` in the Console. I don't have the query perms at the moment — mari, can you run the audit?

mari: Running audit now. Quick temporary patch: change fallback role in Okta mapping to `user` instead of `org-admin` and disable JIT creates. That prevents more noisy admin assignments while we triage.

okta-admin: Done — disabled "Create Users" for the SCIM connector and updated default role to `user`. Change deployed at 1945679000 UTC. Posting Admin log snapshot: 
```json
{"event":"app.provisioning.update","time":"1945679000","changes":[{"field":"create","from":true,"to":false},{"field":"defaultRole","from":"org-admin","to":"user"}]}
```

sre-oncall: I revoked active sessions for 9 affected accounts and disabled existing API keys tied to those profiles. Also planning to rotate the SCIM token — it's KMS-wrapped; will coordinate KMS key rotation with infra.

devin: Opening a PR to harden the mapping logic so empty arrays/strings don't trigger fallback to a high-priv role. PR #1423: `rbac: validate role claim presence and length before fallback` (link posted in thread).

mari: Next steps assigned: 1) Full 24h audit for SSO-created accounts (mari), 2) DB + Okta cross-check for privilege escalations (devin), 3) Rotate SCIM/KMS token and verify connector auth (sre-oncall + infra), 4) Postmortem + timeline (mari).

alex: :thumbsup:

security-bot: Audit export ready: s3://redwood-logs/okta/audit/1945678901.tar.gz

mari: Thanks — once the export and DB lists are in, we'll compile an incident report and notify legal/compliance if any external access occurred. For now mitigation is in place (no new JIT creates, default role lowered, sessions revoked).
